verdict.rationale: Exa ships ready-made agent tools: the exa-js SDK exposes a `webSearch()` helper for use as a `web_search` tool in OpenAI or Anthropic tool-calling loops, with recommended agentic settings. It also offers an official hosted, open-source MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients, including an `agent_run` tool. Further support comes from an official OpenAI plugin listing, installable agent skills for coding agents, and downloadable OpenAPI specs; a community user also reports integrating it into an agentic chatbot. Missing for 10: explicitly published function-calling JSON schemas in the docs, and evidence of integrations with mainstream agent frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex or CrewAI.
